wiki.title: Brian Biggs (politician)
wiki.extract: Brian O'Neal Biggs is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented the 70th district (including parts of Randolph County) since 2023. A former member of the Randolph County Board of Education, he ousted incumbent Pat Hurley in the 2022 primary election.
